summary: The exact change scope and twelve sampled report claims check out. F43-F45 are resolved. The changed report and plan still misclassify Green logs and retain stale log counts.
blocking_findings: F46 [Blocker] review-a: report.md:173 says every other green-*.log and green-at-*.log is a test-run log. Six files contain MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT but no dispositions line, so they are not test-run logs. The report also identifies green-7008ccef.log as an accounting plan at line 33. Correct the log categories.

F47 [Blocker] review-a: plan.md:598–599 says 26 Green role logs hold result markers and dispositions and 45 other logs are test-run logs. The current run directory has 73 green-*.log files: 27 have dispositions lines, 33 have result markers, and 6 marker files lack dispositions. At least one of the remaining files is the accounting plan named in report.md:33. Replace these stale counts with a defined, reproducible inventory or remove them.

F45 withdrawn: read the final eight lines of two GREEN logs and two COVERAGE logs. GREEN logs end with Vitest summaries; COVERAGE logs end with a Coverage summary and percentage rows.
